name: 微信读书
subtitle: 读书时随时问 agent：划线、想法、在读的书
author: 咕咕

contributes.instructions: The person's WeRead (微信读书) books, highlights and thoughts: weread_recent_notes for the line they just marked, weread_book_notes to organise a book.

examples: 我刚在微信读书划的那句是什么意思？
把《思考，快与慢》的划线和想法整理成读书笔记

en.name: WeRead
en.subtitle: Ask about what you read
examples: What does the line I just highlighted in WeRead mean?
Turn my highlights and thoughts in this book into reading notes
